focus: TitanHiding.cs: hiding undiscovered traits from the stats report (cache warm/clear correctness, any leak of hidden-free values into gameplay, CurStage postfix cost and override coverage, Visible side effects of null stage) and GizmosVisible postfix
diffSource: since build 38 (2026-10-06T16:26:17Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Card still gives hidden traits away through capacity and pain values
findings.detail: Begin fills every capacity level, PainTotal and BleedRateTotal with their real values before hiding. Any stat or StatPart that reads capacities (MoveSpeed, melee and work stats via capacity factors) therefore includes a hidden trait's capMods and painOffset/painFactor. Meanwhile the explanation, which is recomputed through the stage built from discovered traits only, does not list them, so value and explanation disagree. Gameplay is safe, but the class summary's promise ('the card's numbers give no hint of hidden traits') is not kept. The one change: correct the TitanHiding summary to say capacity-derived values stay real, or leave capMods/pain out of the warm-up and accept that card-time capacity values are recomputed and must then be cleared in End through capacities.Notify_CapacityLevelsDirty.

findings.title: Begin/End repeat their full cost on every DrawStatsReport call while the card is open
findings.detail: DrawStatsReport(Rect, Thing) caches its rows but calls DrawStatsWorker every time, and GetExplanationText recomputes GetExplanationFull for the selected entry on each call. So Begin/End run on every GUI event, several times per frame. Each run clears every StatDef's cache for the titan twice, rebuilds cardStage (titan.cardStage = null in Begin), and allocates LINQ closures in CollectHiddenHediffs. The cheapest single change: stop nulling cardStage in Begin and End, and null it instead where stageDirty is set and in Notify_TraitDiscovered, so the reduced stage is built once per trait change rather than once per GUI event.

findings.title: CurStage postfix reads the shared hidden-hediff set before checking for the main thread
findings.detail: `hiddenHediffs.Contains(__instance) && UnityData.IsInMainThread` lets another thread call HashSet.Contains while the main thread is adding to it in Begin or clearing it in End. HashSet is not thread-safe. Swapping the two operands, so IsInMainThread is checked first, costs nothing and closes the race. Hediff_Titan.CurStage already checks it this way via HidingFor.

findings.title: Null stage makes hidden-trait hediffs Visible while the card draws
findings.detail: Hediff.Visible returns true when CurStage is null, and these hediffs are meant to have becomeVisible=false stages (TitanTraitDef config error at :212). Vanilla stat code reads Visible only through HediffSet.HasHediff(mustBeVisible) and similar, so inside the card a mustBeVisible check would now find them. No vanilla stats-report path was found that does, so this is benign today.

findings.title: CurStage postfix does not cover overriding subclasses or effects that don't come from the stage
findings.detail: The postfix is on the base getter, so a hidden hediff whose type overrides CurStage without calling base (vanilla Hediff_BandNode, Hediff_DisruptorFlash, or any mod subclass) keeps its stage on the card. Effects that come from HediffComps rather than the stage (for example verb-giving comps feeding melee DPS) are also not hidden.

findings.title: BuildStage signature change silently breaks subclasses compiled against BuildStage()
findings.detail: protected virtual BuildStage() became BuildStage(bool discoveredOnly = false). A dependent mod's compiled override would no longer be called, and a base.BuildStage() call inside it would throw MissingMethodException. No mod in the scanned corpus references Hediff_Titan or BuildStage, so this matters only for unreleased dependents. Worth a changelog line for a framework.

findings.title: Rows built while hiding persist until the card is reopened
findings.detail: cachedDrawEntries is filled once, when empty. If a trait is discovered while the card is open, the left column keeps the values computed without it until StatsReportUtility resets, which happens when the card reopens. Cosmetic only.

checked: all 18 [HarmonyPatch] targets bind, including DrawStatsReport(Rect, Thing) choosing one of 7 overloads, Hediff.get_CurStage and Ability.GizmosVisible (verify_patches)
Prefix/Finalizer share __state, so End runs even when drawing throws; nested or second cards are refused by the cardPawn != null guard
StatWorker.ClearCacheForThing clears both temporaryStatCache and immutableStatCache, so values computed without hidden traits during the card are dropped in End

HediffSet's other stage-derived caches (cachedEnabledNeeds/DisabledNeeds, thought nullification, cachedDamageFactors) are filled only on DirtyCache or from the damage path, not during a card draw, so…
PawnCapacitiesHandler.GetLevel stores what it computes, so warming before hiding means the card reads, and never rewrites, the real capacity values
Hediff_Titan.CurStage returns cardStage only under HidingFor (main thread, same pawn); cachedStage/stageDirty are left alone while hiding
Ability.GizmosVisible's only consumer is Pawn_AbilityTracker.GetGizmos, so the postfix cannot stop AI casting; non-titan abilities return false from AbilityOnlyFromHiddenTraits
